name: basin_convergence
claim: The uncertainty exponent measured for the triple-well basin boundary is converged in grid resolution and integration time: doubling either changes alpha by less than 0.05, at every damping swept.
refute_if: |alpha(2N) - alpha(N)| >= 0.05 OR |alpha(2T) - alpha(T)| >= 0.05 - either at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept gamma
